hits.title: Ask HN: Solo founder, pre-seed: looking for a cofounder after launch?
hits.story_text: Launched a scheduling tool for physiotherapists in June, solo, pre-seed, a handful of paying users. I am now looking for a cofounder with a sales background but every intro feels like a job interview. Did you look for a cofounder after launch, and how did you meet them?

hits.author: mtrace_fictive
hits.comment_text: Thanks all. Two people offered intros, I will report back on how it goes.

hits.author: mtrace_fictive
